overview_description.description: MyVR, a Guesty company, is a cloud-based, multi-channel management platform that provides short-term rental businesses with the ability to simplify and centralize property management across key booking channels from a single dashboard. The software streamlines and automates day-to-day tasks in order to save businesses time and resources, reduce efforts and improve the experience of travelers.

product.name: Channel Manager
product.description: A centralized hub for managing listings across multiple channels to maximize performance.

product.name: Guesty CRM
product.description: Collects and manages reservation opportunities, transforming them into satisfied guest experiences.

product.name: Unified Inbox
product.description: A single destination for managing guest communication across various formats and channels.

product.name: Multi-Calendar
product.description: Syncs data from all listings to view, track, filter, and adjust reservations in one place.

product.name: Payment Solutions
product.description: Offers a range of tools for simplifying the financial aspects of the business, including payment processing.

product.name: Automation Tools
product.description: Automates routine tasks like guest communication and pricing to save time and reduce errors.
